title: Buttons and captions — matched to the app

steps.headline: 20. The action is a real button, and the caption is gone.
steps.changed: Full width, primary, the size the app uses in a dialog — the same treatment as Install Workspace on the current screen. The greyed-out look and the preview caption are deleted.
steps.notice: It reads as a button you press, not a disabled one with an apology under it.
steps.risk: It still does nothing when pressed.

steps.path: Settings → Development → Contribute → How contributing works
steps.headline: 21. Same button, under the five steps.
steps.changed: The same restyle, seen with the walkthrough open. Nothing about the five steps changed.
steps.notice: The action now spans the dialog instead of hiding in the corner.
steps.risk: None — this is the same change as 20.

steps.headline: 22. You approved this screen; only its button changed.
steps.changed: Review ticket becomes a full-width primary button. It still stays inactive until you have typed a title and a description — that is real behaviour, not a mockup.
steps.notice: The rows and headings you approved are untouched.
steps.risk: Reopening an approved screen. Say no and it goes back.

steps.headline: 23. No captions anywhere, and two stacked buttons.
steps.changed: Every preview and prototype caption is deleted. Error details now shows a real version line instead of saying nothing was collected. Submit is primary, Back to draft is the outlined one under it.
steps.notice: Nothing on the screen tells you it is a mockup.
steps.risk: Submit and the AI button do nothing yet.
